_about: Vana'News on the launcher's Play page. Newest first. The launcher shows the first 8 and caches the last copy it fetched.

items.title: Chocobo racing and breeding
items.body: Chocobo racing is open at the Circuit's Paddock Clerk, from C4 to C1, with gil prizes, racing levels and bonus points. Breeding passes on part of the parents' racing bonuses, and raising food and care gains are improved. Race your own bird; traded chococards are for breeding. Item prizes are not included yet.

items.title: Odyssey Sheol and Skillz Rings
items.body: Sheol A, B and C have revised camps, species, landings and translocators, with higher enemy HP. Halo squads and reward paths are installed for live testing; please report route, fight or reward problems. Moogle Mode grants a Skillz Ring, and existing characters missing one were sent it through the delivery box.

items.title: New battles and endgame repairs
items.body: Master Trials, Wings of War and Ode of Life Bestowing are installed with their rewards and Emporox services. Ambuscade encounter mechanics, Abyssea Dominion repeat credit and morale, the Nyzul staging lamp, Domain Invasion trusts and Walk of Echoes reward returns have fixes. Individual fights and rewards still need in-game checks.

items.title: Divergence reopens and mission fixes
items.body: Dynamis - Divergence entry is open again. Magian shield trials, Moogle Mode skip rewards and Rhapsodies progress have repairs. Omen takes the whole party, Voidwatch uses carried voidstones before officer stock, and Divine Might can be repeated for each earring. Trust, login and map-server crash fixes are also included.

items.title: Classic Limbus, Salvage II and Adoulin
items.body: Classic level-75 Limbus is available alongside current Limbus, with the original entry requirements. The four Salvage II runs, Meeble Burrows expeditions and all 90 Coalition Assignments are live. Adoulin services, Mog Garden, Bard, Puppetmaster, Geomancer, Summoner and Treasure Hunter received updates.

items.title: Clan Centurio, upgrades and trust orders
items.body: Clan Centurio's NM-hunting expansion is enabled in Lower Jeuno, with bills, Warbands, crafting rewards, a shared Clan Vault and Clan Bank. Nolan and Oboro upgrade paths, trust leader and aggro orders, Rem's Tales storage and Porter slips 29/30 are included, alongside progression, combat and travel fixes.

items.title: VanaGear 0.2.0 and launcher 0.2.50
items.body: VanaGear now writes a profile for each job, shaped for how that job plays, and swaps only from it. A Settings tab, every /vg command listed in the window, and trusts that get the gear you and your other trusts are not using. The launcher stops carrying macros between game copies and turns LuAshitacast off when VanaGear is on.

items.title: Moogle Mode
items.body: A third character mode: Vana'diel without the grind. Choose it once at Mog the Merciful. The server is now vanadreams.online and the site vanadreams.org.

items.title: Endgame fixes
items.body: A.M.A.N. Trove sacks open, every Salvage cell counts, Nyzul Isle token floors pay out, and fixes across the Sea, the Sky and Einherjar.

items.title: Hotfixes
items.body: Every notorious monster drops one endgame material for sure. Classic mode starts you with a trust party, and the Login Moogle sells the Records of Eminence trusts.

items.title: The October update
items.body: Standard experience and drops with capacity points at 10x, Classic mode, endgame upgrade materials, Legion, Besieged, Clan Centurio and over 3,800 Magian trials.

items.title: Gear your trusts
items.body: VanaGear 0.1.10 gives each trust you call its own tab in /vg, with Idle, Engaged and per-ability sets from your bags. Your trusts use those sets' stats. No trust tabs? Quit the launcher from the tray, open it again and press Play. Also new: capacity points at 50x, and no more waits between endgame entries.

items.title: Sunday update
items.body: Einherjar opens, Nyzul Isle bosses arrive and limit breaks get their rework.

items.title: Faster leveling, bigger drops
items.body: Experience and Records of Eminence are up a third, capacity points are boosted and drop rates are higher across the board.

items.title: Login Campaign changes from 25 Oct
items.body: A monthly 500 point bonus, no cap, and Dark Matter in the shop at 1,000 points.

items.title: Bank of Vana'diel
items.body: Loans are open. Visit the Bank Clerk at the hangout.
